journeys.name: Service category: save, parent, deactivate and delete
journeys.objective: The kinds of service the hospital buys exist as a tree, each with its purchase account and service center.
journeys.userRole: Services administrator (test persona; only admin was available)
journeys.steps:
1. Opens Services and clicks Service category in the menu
2. Clicks "Save category"
3. Types code and name, checks the account and the service center and clicks "Save"
4. Saves the child category with the parent code in "Parent"
5. Opens the dialog, types the code of the child, chooses "Deactivate" and clicks "Save"

journeys.userRole: Not signed in; admin of a tenant without the licence; a role without the write privilege
journeys.preconditions: A browser without a session; for the licence and privilege cases, accounts that are not available yet.
journeys.steps:
1. Without a session, opens /id/services
2. On a tenant without the licence, opens /id/services
3. With a role without the write privilege, tries to save on a screen of the application
journeys.expectedOutcome: 1. Redirect to /id/login?next=/services. 2. Redirect to /id/apps (frontend/src/proxy.ts, features/licensing/assert-entitled.ts; licence KLIKMED-IP); the API answers 403 "not entitled for this module". 3. The API answers 403 "missing required privilege".
journeys.observedOutcome: 2026-10-12: without a session /id/services ended at /id/login?next=%2Fservices (HTTP 200). Steps 2 and 3 not executed: no second tenant and no restricted account were authorised.
journeys.alternativePaths: Deep link to a sub-screen instead of the landing screen.
journeys.failureScenarios: Session expired while a form is open (TBD: behaviour not confirmed).
journeys.dependencies: Accounts per role; a tenant without the licence (README lists the other showcase hosts)
journeys.validationNotes: Generated in this run. Read routes of the application are guarded by the licence only, not by a role (see RISK-01 in qa/open-questions.md).
